An '''Unidentified Sith Lord''' was present on board the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[War Hammer]] during the [[Attack on the Hidden Temple]], and acted as the Sith overseer to the crew of the ''War Hammer''.

During the course of the battle [[Darth Krayt]]'s [[Darth Krayt's Sith trooper|Sith troopers]] arrived and began fighting, killing a large number of combatants on both sides. Also when [[Darth Rauder]] sensed the presence of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] younglings on a fleeing vessel, she ordered [[1st Imperial Center Core Defense Squadron|Skull Squadron]] to shoot it down, however [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gunn Yage]] reached a line that she would not cross and shot down Rauder instead.

Captain Yage then communicated her intentions to defect to her father [[Rulf Yage]] on board the ''War Hammer''. The Sith Lord ordered [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Yage]] to shoot his daughter down, but he had also had enough of the [[One Sith]] and decided to defect. The elder Yage pulled a blaster out and shot the Sith Lord [[Death/Legends|dead]]. He then sent out a transmission declaring that he was joining his daughter in defecting.
